limits: No real GPU oracle, full-world zero-image test or GPU speedup has been performed by this subagent.
GPU compilers may fuse/reassociate across the RGBA32F materialization boundary; any actual readback/image difference must block adoption.
First observed draw stays on original formula; next prepare may allocate/evaluate. New shader variants require actual warmup.
Main and native CSM/reflection physical meshes may reuse only a matching snapshot. Private coverage views deliberately execute the original formula.
Projected depth wrapper is inherited and then explicitly re-applied idempotently: distinct program key and potential first compile, never a uniform-only family certificate.
Extra target writes, two submissions and per-vertex texture fetch may cost more than saved arithmetic; no runtime default promotion.
Frame edits follow Three needsUpdate; source/root/matrix/layout/time identities are checked, large immutable source arrays are not rescanned per draw.
